description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, user account management, and task management in a FastAPI application. It includes route handlers for user registration, login, retrieving current user info, and CRUD operations for tasks, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and completing tasks.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user entity with fields like id, email, full_name, and is_active.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user, including email, password, and full name.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents an authentication token with access_token and token_type.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a task with fields such as id, title, description, due_date, completed, created_at, updated_at, assigned_to, and creator_id.

classes.name: TaskCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new task, including title, description, due_date, and optional assigned_to.

classes.name: TaskList
classes.description: Wrapper for a list of tasks.

methods.name: register(user_create: UserCreate)
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user account if the email isn't already registered.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends())
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token upon successful login.

methods.name: create_task(task: TaskCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new task assigned to the current user or specified user.

methods.name: list_tasks(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns a list of tasks assigned to or created by the current user, supporting pagination.

methods.name: get_task(task_id: int = Path(..., gt=0), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task by its ID, ensuring the user has access.

methods.name: update_task(task_id: int, task: TaskUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates task details or status for a specific task.

methods.name: delete_task(task_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a specified task if the user has permission.
